content: योक्त्रम् .²1 A cord, rope, thong, halter. .²2 The tie of the yoke of a plough. .²3 The rope by which an animal is tied to the pole of a carriage; छेदने चैव यन्त्राणां योक्त्ररश्म्योस्तथैव च <ls>Ms. 8. 292</ls>. .²4 A churning cord; ततो निश्चित्य मथनं योक्त्रं कृत्वा च वासुकिम् <ls>Rām. 1. 45. 18</ls>, <ls n="Rām. 1. 45.">19</ls>.
